subject.title: fix(plugins): run message_sending on all channel agent-reply deliveries (#92374)

question: Should this comprehensive PR remain the canonical repair for the configured-dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final `message_sending` bypass once the suffix re-entry blocker is fixed?
rationale: The PR changes a pre-send safety hook boundary, adds an internal opt-out, and overlaps several narrower open fix PRs, so maintainers need to choose the permanent canonical branch and accepted exactly-once semantics.

options.title: Repair And Keep This Branch
options.body: Fix suffix hook re-entry on this PR, refresh proof, and use it as the canonical comprehensive repair.

options.title: Land Dispatcher-Only First
options.body: Use a narrower dispatcher PR first and keep Telegram streamed-final coverage tracked separately.

options.title: Accept Per-Suffix Gating
options.body: Only accept the current shape if maintainers intentionally drop the exactly-once claim and document per-suffix safety-hook behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair And Keep This Branch
recommendation.body: Fix suffix hook re-entry on this PR, refresh proof, and use it as the canonical comprehensive repair.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight owns the current comprehensive branch and is the assignee most directly positioned to repair or split it.
